item.title: Governing street vendors, assembling differentiated Chinese statehood: The case of Guanting Street, Hefei
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Werewolf to Rudolph: Urban disciplining in public space and bubble acculturation of migrants
item.content:encoded:
Urban Studies, Ahead of Print.
Most research on migrant acculturation focuses on transnational, multi-ethnic contexts. This article examines internal rural-to-urban migrants in China, exploring how urban public space shapes their place-based acculturation. It rethinks acculturation ...
